csv_project_name: Architectural Services for TSD - New District Office
csv_scope_of_work: Timpanogos School District (TSD) is requesting statements of qualifications from qualified Architectural firms to provide the design and related architectural services for a new District Office. Working in coordination with Timpanogos School District, provide Architectural Services for a new District Office (approximately 22,000 sq. ft.) on an undeveloped portion (approximately 1 acre) of an existing district site located in Lindon, Utah.
